reason: The price range is fine, but I would be paying an installer I have never met for work I cannot see until it is done. I already have a workshop I trust and I negotiate with them face to face, so I would have to be convinced the partners are better than the people I know.
objection: Quotes may take hours or days and I want a price now, and I do not know who these partners are or what happens if the film is badly fitted after the money is held.
would_change_my_mind: A partner I can visit in Riyadh before paying, or a recommendation from a workshop I already trust, plus a quick same-day price.
